text:
Palladium Price in 2021
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2021, the LBMA palladium price fell 15.2% between 2021-01-29 ($2,327) and 2021-12-30 ($1,973). The highest sampled price was $2,981 in April and the lowest was $1,767 in November. The mean of these observations was $2,382. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
